interface: Analog 0-3.0 V into SIM4 ADC via divider (dry reference kept below 2.8 V); wetter soil reads LOWER voltage

measurands.name: raw_mv
measurands.accuracy: raw oscillator output; meaningless without calibration anchors

measurands.name: moisture_pct
measurands.accuracy: repeatability ~±3-5% of scale after two-point calibration; no absolute vendor spec

calibration.procedure: agent-guided: hold in dry air (anchor_dry), immerse sensing area in water (anchor_wet); anchors stored in SIM NVS and mirrored here

failure_modes: sudden drop to dry-air reading: probe pulled out or soil shrunk away from the paddle, not instant drought
reading pinned wet after irrigation: waterlogged pot or water film on the collar
calibration lost after SIM replacement: anchors live per probe, re-run the dialogue
mounting: fully inserted to the collar line, firm soil contact, electronics end above grade and rain-protected
